items.explanation: The Dockerfile lacks a `USER` instruction, which prevents the user namespace from being enforced. This can lead to privilege escalation attacks.
items.fix:
Add a `USER` instruction for the root user, followed by a `RUN` to set the environment variables: 

```diff
FROM example/base:1
+LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="Demo web service"
```

This ensures the root user namespace is enforced.

Quality.note: Reordered `FROM` line and added `LABEL` to align with the README file changes, maintaining the 'The service listens on port 8080.'

Documentation.note: Update Dockerfile and README.md to reflect the new image title and port number.
